title: Ansh Rastogi — Professional Overview & Bio
content: Ansh Rastogi is a Full-Stack Developer, AI Engineer, and Backend Architect based in Noida, India. He is currently pursuing his B.Tech at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology (NIT) Jalandhar in the Department of Instrumentation and Control Engineering, graduating in the Class of 2026. Ansh is actively open to full-time SDE, Backend, Full-Stack, and AI engineering roles. He is a 4x Hackathon Finalist, has completed 5 professional internships, and maintains 31+ public GitHub repositories. Contact: rastogiansh13@gmail.com.

title: Campus Leadership & Extracurriculars — StrataBiz NITJ
content: At NIT Jalandhar, Ansh served as a core member and student head of StrataBiz, the official Business Analytics and Consulting Club of NIT Jalandhar. He has organized national-level case study competitions, mentored junior engineers in software development, and is a 4x national hackathon finalist.

title: Lovers.Ai — AI Full-Stack Intern
content: Role: AI Full-Stack Intern at Lovers.Ai. Built AI-powered wedding planning features with workflow automation, intelligent task orchestration, and real-time collaboration tools. Tech stack: React.js, Node.js, OpenAI API, AI Agents. Also developed the open-source Lover.ai-crm and LoversAi repositories on GitHub.

title: UBNext — Full-Stack Developer Intern
content: Role: Full-Stack Developer Intern at UBNext. Developed production-ready web applications on a scalable backend, with real-time features, REST API integrations, and database performance optimization. Tech stack: Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker. Associated with proprietary enterprise logistics repositories including boxesnbottles.

title: QSkills — Backend Developer Intern
content: Role: Backend Developer Intern at QSkills. Built and maintained scalable REST APIs, implemented secure JWT authentication, and significantly reduced response latency via Redis caching strategies. Tech stack: Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, REST APIs, Redis.

title: Edulyt India — Data Analyst Intern
content: Role: Data Analyst Intern at Edulyt India. Analyzed high-volume transaction datasets using Python, Pandas, and NumPy. Designed interactive business intelligence dashboards and automated management reporting pipelines in Power BI.

title: AD Infocom Pvt. Ltd. — Frontend Developer Intern
content: Role: Frontend Developer Intern at AD Infocom Pvt. Ltd. Built modern, accessible UI components and landing pages, translating complex Figma design specifications into high-performance React.js code styled with Tailwind CSS.
